name: cars-modern
description: English modern-car videos using the exact title you submit. No title-research or title-selection gate.
channel_context: an English long-form channel about modern vehicles from roughly model year 2000 onward, including combustion, hybrid and electric powertrains, safety systems, software, infotainment, connectivity, efficiency, regulation, ADAS, and the ownership tradeoffs created by new technology
audience_line: speaks to one current or prospective owner who wants modern vehicle technology explained accurately without marketing hype or anti-technology panic

host.persona: A technically literate modern-car journalist who can explain mechanical, electrical, battery, software, and regulatory systems while separating verified capability from advertising and speculation.
host.register: Current, analytical, visually clear, and balanced. Explain acronyms and avoid treating one market, trim, software version, or test result as universal.

style.broll_style: cinematic contemporary cars, EV charging, hybrid and combustion powertrains, dashboards without readable personal data, sensors, batteries and electronics, modern roads and test facilities, realistic interfaces and vehicle geometry, no visible trademarks
style.music_style: clean contemporary technology-documentary score, subtle electronic pulse, precise percussion and warm low synths, optimistic but neutral, no vocals

writing_sections.name: modern_tension
writing_sections.hint: Open with the verified capability, limitation, or ownership tradeoff that makes this modern-car topic matter now.

writing_sections.name: system_context
writing_sections.hint: Define the technology, model years, markets, trims, hardware and software versions, and regulatory context needed to understand the topic.

writing_sections.name: how_it_works
writing_sections.hint: Explain the mechanical, electrical, software, energy, or sensing chain accurately and distinguish design intent from measured performance.

writing_sections.name: benefits_limits_ownership
writing_sections.hint: Evaluate benefits, failure modes, usability, repairability, cost, privacy, efficiency, or safety tradeoffs only when they can be stated with clear conditions and dates.

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: State the most defensible conclusion, explain what varies or may change, invite a specific viewer perspective, and add a soft subscription invitation. {LIKE_SUBSCRIBE}

cta_lines.like_subscribe: Ask viewers to name their market, model year, trim, or software version when sharing experience, then softly invite them to subscribe.

north_star: Explain modern car technology without marketing hype, fear, or false universality. Version, date, market, model year, trim, test conditions, and evidence type remain visible in every important claim.
outline_extras: Attach an as-of date to current claims in the private outline and flag facts requiring verification. Separate regulation, manufacturer specification, independent measurement, and anecdotal experience.
rules: Preserve as-of dates for current claims and omit details that cannot be stated confidently.
Distinguish markets, model years, trims, battery sizes, drivetrains, charging standards, hardware generations, software versions, option packages, and test conditions.
Never imply driver-assistance is autonomous driving or encourage hands-off/inattentive use beyond the verified operating design domain.
Never invent range, charging speed, efficiency, acceleration, safety performance, prices, subscription terms, availability, recalls, or future product plans.
Separate rated or manufacturer figures from independent tests and real-world anecdotes.
Do not offer high-voltage repair instructions or defeat emissions, security, privacy, or safety systems.
Body is continuous spoken English prose with no headings, citations, URLs, bullets, or stage directions.

hook_types.bold_statement: State the strongest verified modern-vehicle tradeoff without turning a dated or conditional fact into a universal claim.
hook_types.question: Ask a concrete technology, ownership, safety, efficiency, or repairability question the video can answer precisely.
hook_types.short_story: Open on a real-world modern-car moment where hardware, software, energy, or human behavior changes the outcome without inventing a documented incident.
hook_types.pattern_break: Correct marketing hype or reflexive skepticism only when the correction can be stated confidently and precisely.
